verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides self-hosted CI/CD with GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows, directly supporting the ability to run jobs on private/self-hosted runners (gitea-docs-2). However, no community evidence in the pack validates hands-on use of Gitea Actions runners specifically; the only CI-related community mention pairs Gitea with a separate tool (Drone) rather than Gitea's native Actions, suggesting native runner support may be newer/less proven.
